user.title: Add Symi Mesh integration
user.description:
Choose what to add:

• **Mesh gateway**: connect over TCP or serial; all mesh devices behind the gateway are discovered automatically (unique entities derived from MAC).
• **KNX bidirectional sync**: sync state between any Home Assistant entities (e.g. official KNX entities and symi_mesh entities).

gateway.title: Connection type
gateway.description:
The mesh gateway supports TCP (LAN, default port 4196) and serial (RS485/USB, 115200 8N1).

Detected serial ports: {ports}

gateway_tcp.title: TCP parameters
gateway_tcp.description: Gateway IP address and TCP port (default 4196). Settings are validated by a live connection and device-list read before saving.

gateway_serial.title: Serial parameters
gateway_serial.description:
Serial device path and baud rate (default 115200).

Detected serial ports: {ports}

knx_sync.title: Add bidirectional sync group

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the gateway. Check address/port/serial path and make sure the gateway is online.

abort.already_configured: An entry with the same connection/entity set already exists

init.title: Gateway options
init.description: Tune reconnection and reporting behaviour. Changes reload the integration automatically.

reload.name: Reload
reload.description: Reload all gateway and sync-group entries.

scan_devices.name: Scan devices
scan_devices.description: Re-request the device list from the gateway to pick up newly added mesh devices.

describe.name: Describe
describe.description: Write sync queue/loop-cache snapshots to the log (diagnostics, do not call frequently).
